title: RFID
summary: Scan, dump, emulate and manage NFC/UHF tags
description: RFID for CardputerZero: READ, SAVED, EMU and TOOLS for NFC/UHF readers. Includes M5 NFC CAP (SPI), M5 NFC Unit (IIC), PN532 and PN532Killer workflows, saved MFC dump writing, MFKey32v2/MFKey64/Staticnested tools and JSON-backed NTAG emulation. Hardware support varies by function. SPI MFC 1K encrypted emulation remains experimental and is disabled by default; it is not advertised as a stable feature.
